title: SkillInvocationEvent
description: One line of ~/.cc-skill-trace/events.jsonl — a single Claude Code skill invocation. Mirrors src/core/types.ts; kept in sync by hand (#106).

id.description: Unique event ID. The tool_use block ID when scanned from a session log, or a random UUID when captured live by the hook.

v.description: Event schema version. Absent on legacy v1 events written before this field existed; readers must treat a missing v as 1.

sessionId.description: Claude Code session ID this invocation belongs to.

skillName.description: Name of the invoked skill, as passed to the Skill tool.

skillArgs.description: Arguments passed to the skill invocation, if any.

source.description: "user" for an explicit /skill-name slash command, "claude" when Claude auto-invoked the skill.

triggerMessage.description: The user message that immediately preceded this invocation, truncated. Omitted when capture is disabled (#74) or unavailable (hook-captured events without a scan backfill).

injectedTokens.description: Estimated token count of the skill content injected into context.

cwd.description: Working directory at time of invocation.

gitBranch.description: Git branch at time of invocation.

recordedVia.description: How the event entered the store: real-time PreToolUse hook capture, or retroactive session-log scan.

outcome.description: Invocation result reported by the PostToolUse hook (#144).

durationMs.description: Milliseconds between the PreToolUse and PostToolUse hooks, when both fired (#144).
